title: A retry after idempotency state expires
prompt: A reservation API retains idempotency records for 24 hours. Once a record expires and is purged, it treats the same key as a new request. No other reservation identifier or reconciliation lookup exists. Event E1 is tenant=acme, key=k-66, body={room:R7}; it creates reservation res-77 with HTTP 201. Event E2 is the same tenant, key, and body 48 hours later, after the original record is purged; it creates reservation res-78 with HTTP 201. Both responses reach the client. For each event, report the actual server HTTP status (null only if the scenario does not establish it), response_observed, business_effect_delta (new reservations), external_effect_delta, and response_ref. Then report exactly reservation_count and active_idempotency_records in final_state.
